thread:
maria-devex: heads up — got a customer report where requests from Vercel Edge Functions started returning 401s after we published ts-sdk v1.8.0. Non-edge (server) calls fine.
kevin-support: when did the upgrade happen and can you share a minimal repro?
maria-devex: rolled last night. repro: Next.js edge middleware calling our client. error in prod logs: `401 unauthorized` with empty `authorization` header on outbound request to api.redwood.com. dev/local works.
maria-devex: pasted package.json from the build artifact and the export resolution that shipped:

```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/ts-sdk",
  "version": "1.8.0",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./": {
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
    }
  }
}
```

maria-devex: bundler is Next 13 (Turbopack disabled), esbuild-based production build.
kevin-support: interesting — edge runtimes often prefer ESM. If the bundler resolves `require` path in SSR/edge context to the CJS entry, some polyfills (fetch/auth shim) might not be wired. can you share what the edge bundle contains?
jordan-eng: quick guess — esbuild flattened the require path and removed the small shim that attaches authorization header in our runtime wrapper. In v1.7.x we had a small `runtime/adapters/edge.ts` that gets tree-shaken only when `import` condition selected. If consumers end up using the CJS build (`require`), the adapter isn't included and our client fallback to node http client which strips the header in edge envs.
sophie-sdk: do we have a failing test that covers edge function bundle? I think our CI doesn't run Next edge packaging.
ci-bot: workflow run 8472 failed: `integration:edge-packaging` not present for tag v1.8.0.
kevin-support: for immediate mitigation can customer pin to 1.7.3? and can we publish 1.8.1 with a tiny change — ensure `exports` include explicit `conditions` for edge? e.g. add `"edge"` condition or move the ESM entry to top-level so bundlers pick it by default.
maria-devex: customer can try pin, but they prefer a fix from us. I can repro locally with `npx vercel` emulate edge: their bundle shows `require("@redwood/ts-sdk/dist/index.cjs")` inlined.
jordan-eng: workaround patch: change package.json exports to: 
```json
"exports": {
  "./": {
    "default": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  }
}
```
That nudges bundlers to prefer the ESM path as `default`. Also include a tiny `package.json` condition `"types": "dist/index.d.ts"` already set. Then republish.
sophie-sdk: also add a smoke test: build Next demo app and assert header set in edge invocation. Short-term we can publish `1.8.1-edgefix` to canary.
kevin-support: did you capture the exact failing header in logs? that would help rule out auth server change.
maria-devex: yes — raw outgoing HTTP (from edge runtime) shows `authorization: ` (empty) in our Telemetry debug. inbound client call had token in env. So something in client wiring lost it.
sophie-sdk: another angle — some bundlers replace `process.env` or polyfill for edge which can change how `getAuth()` runs. Make sure the auth getter isn't behind a dynamic `require` that bundlers drop.
jordan-eng: action items: 1) tag a canary 1.8.1 with exports default->mjs (kevin), 2) add Next edge smoke in CI (sophie), 3) reach out to customer with pin instructions and ETA (maria). I'll open a quick PR.
kevin-support: sending pin instructions: `npm i @redwood/ts-sdk@1.7.3` and set ENV REDWOOD_SDK_FALLBACK=1 to force old adapter.
maria-devex: thanks — I'll update customer. will paste repro bundle slice once PR merged. :thumbsup:
